name: B10-0454/2025 (PPE) – Situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for stronger pressure on Belarus's leader, Aliaksandr Lukashenka, five years after an election it says was rigged. It asks for more sanctions, asset freezes and a special EU envoy to negotiate the release of political prisoners. It also wants support for the democratic opposition led by Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya, easier visas for Belarusians fleeing repression, and accountability for crimes including the deportation of Ukrainian children. These are political demands, not decisions that change law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands more sanctions, asset freezes and an EU envoy for Belarus.
- **Who it affects:** Lukashenka's officials, political prisoners, and Belarusians seeking EU visas.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU governments and institutions, which decide whether to act.
